items.Name: Amulet of Loyalty
items.Description: This amulet is adorned with metallic teeth that point inward toward the wearer's neck in a disturbing manner.

items.Name: Talisman of Inexistence
items.Description: The stone that hangs upon this necklace is not a stone at all. It is an absence, a hole in existence. Its wearer can turn ethereal several times per day, and project a beam of negative energy at will. And if the stone is taken and thrown, it implodes into a vortex of nothingness…
PropertiesDecoded: Negative Energy Ray (3) Cast Spell Unlimited Uses/Day

items.Name: Amulet of the wolf
items.Description: On his sixth birthday, young Asher Sigerthennen was taken by his father on a hunting trip. On that day, the boy made his first kill, a mother wolf pregnant with young. Proud of his son, Lord Beliar had a local artisan craft an amulet from the teeth of the wolf and had it enchant…

items.Name: Arxtenachewwan's Introduction to the Arcane
items.Description: This old and worn-out book serves as an introduction to the arts of arcane magic. It was written by the archmage Arxtenachewwan in 992 LR and has often been used in teaching the magical arts. Without the guidance of a mentor, however, the symbols within are impossible to follow.…

items.Name: Large Shield +2
items.Description: This magic shield grants additional protection to its wearer, but it doesn't bear the hallmarks of any specific maker.

items.Name: Large Shield +2
items.Description: This magic shield grants additional protection to its wearer, but it doesn't bear the hallmarks of any specific maker.

items.Name: At Home in a Ragnathar Kitchen
items.Description:
This book is a compilation of recipes for the kind of food eaten by the Ragnathar barbarians, with a short introduction by Bruhar the Bloodletter.

Most of the recipes are pretty simple variations of roasted meats, but they are not easy to prepare because they are all designed t…

items.Name: Ayganja
items.Description: When crushed and smoked in a pipe, the Ayganja leaves give off a pungent and intoxicating odor. Although officially illegal on the streets of Endorr, they are nevertheless quite common.

items.Name: Backpack
items.Description: This is a standard backpack useful for carrying miscellaneous items.

items.Name: Note
items.Description:
"Arranging your release was not easy, and I can only do it one more time. So be more careful in the future.

-DV"

items.Name: Glass globe
items.Description: This small glass globe seems completely ordinary. You can sense no magic dweomer on it at all.

items.Name: Drunhrad Draught
items.Description: This brew has a crunchy texture and packs a heady wallop.
PropertiesDecoded: Alcohol, Beer Cast Spell Single Use

items.Name: Blackthread Leather
items.Description: Such armor is worn by mid-level operatives of the League of Twilight, at the rank of "blackcloak". It is specially treated to blend into shadows and to make as little noise as possible.

items.Name: Blade of Justice
items.Description: It is said that the god Pallas, patron of kings, dispenses justice in the form of these wondrous swords. However, most scholars believe that the power of the blade comes not from the divine hand of Pallas himself, but through the same kind of blessing that is bestowed upon those…
PropertiesDecoded: Evil Enhancement Bonus vs. Alignment Group +2
Lawful Good Use Limitation: Specific Alignment

items.Name: Urn of Blasting Ash
items.Description:
This small urn is filled with volatile "blasting ash" which explodes when exposed to fire. It was given to you by Loriana who wants you to use it to obtain the amulet of baron Varastii.

To detonate it, place the urn on the ground and throw a flask of achemist's fire near it (bu…

items.Name: Urn of Blasting Ash
items.Description: This small urn is filled with volatile "blasting ash" which explodes when exposed to fire. To detonate it, place the urn on the ground and throw a flask of achemist's fire near it (but not directly at it). Do this from a distance.

items.Name: Bloodshroom
items.Description: When thrown, the bloodshroom bulb explodes into a cloud of tiny green spores that can cause uncontrollable choking.
PropertiesDecoded: Choking Powder Cast Spell Single Use

items.Name: Malek's Magnificent Boots of Avoidance
items.Description: The legendary thief Malek of Endorr is said to have received this pair of boots from the archmage of Asilgard in thanks for his role in bringing peace to the lands of Beleria. Although they protected him from all kinds of traps and spells, they ultimately did not protect him fro…

items.Name: Cloak of Shadows
items.Description: Contrary to common lore, not all Shadow Thieves are experts at walking in shadow. In fact, some of them would never have mastered their art were it not for these exquisite cloaks. The fabric draws shadows to enfold the wearer, and the collar is enchanted with a single-use spell,…

items.Name: Clock
items.Description: This fancy clock was built by Lagur de'Verklakar, a gnomish clockmaker of some renown. Only a few are in existence.

items.Name: Crude Map
items.Description: Upon this parchment, somebody has sketched a crude map. This map depicts what appears as a series of islands forming a curved archipelago. Various symbols are drawn around the map, some crossed out and replaced by others. None of these symbols mean anything to you, and they don'…

items.Name: Demilune Crescent
items.Description: The head of this magical sickle is a complex weave made from strands of moonlight frozen into solid form by powerful abjurations. Such weapons are only wielded by respected warrior priests of the moon goddess, Selene.
PropertiesDecoded: Evil Attack Bonus vs. Alignment Group +2

items.Name: Diary of Marko Bweibert
items.Description:
Most of the pages of this diary have been ripped out, leaving only fragments. The remaining pages have been soaked through and only a few are still legible:

"...ldmaster has them all on his puppet strings, even Akasha. Her paranoia does not extend nearly far enough, and she fai…

items.Name: Dilemmas of Prognostication
items.Description: This academic text, by one Emelchior Salmakan, discusses the apparent inconsistency between the concept of free will and the ability to see the future. It begins with a careful historical account of some of the most well-documented cases of prophetic visions which predicted futu…

items.Name: Disarm Kit
items.Description: This device, when activated, causes all nearby traps to be disarmed.
PropertiesDecoded: Find Traps (3) Cast Spell Single Use

items.Name: Doom blade
items.Description: Before Lothar of Xenegath conquered the western reaches of what is now the kingdom of Beleria, these lands were inhabited by the orcish hordes of Kruth. The orcs were a violent and primitive race, constantly fighting amongst themselves even while the Lotharyan armies marched upo…
PropertiesDecoded: Doom On Hit Cast Spell Level 1
Scare On Hit Cast Spell Level 1

items.Name: Efijingko
items.Description: This object gives you the creeps. It is a large doll made from real human bones and covered in pink clay crudely resembling skin. It is tightly wrapped in rags soaked in some kind of foul-smelling oil. From the base protrudes a wooden spike by which, it seems, the doll is intend…
PropertiesDecoded: Unique Power Self Only Cast Spell Single Use

items.Name: Elemental Token
items.Description: A diamond-shaped rune is inscribed in this small piece of magnetite.

items.Name: Replica of "Chivalry"
items.Description: This is a perfectly crafted replica of the famous sword "Chivalry". You've been hired to switch it for the real thing.

items.Name: Unar's Key
items.Description: This key has the name "The Ebony Thrall" written on it.

items.Name: Note from Feyal
items.Description:
"I have a simple task for you. I want you to kill Kastin Borias, the man who you once helped escape from Endorr prison. How you do it is up to you, but it is imperative that my involvement is not known to other members of the guild.

If you do this to my satisfaction, your rewar…

items.Name: Note from Feyal
items.Description:
"I have a new task for you, and it is of utmost importance. Surely you remember my ghostly elven masterspy. Well, it seems that the elf has been plotting against me behind my back, and I cannot let that continue. Therefore, I want you to destroy him, once and for all.

His name …

items.Name: FeyalsArm
items.Description: Such armor is worn only by the highest masters of the League of Twilight, augmenting their skills.

items.Name: Fire dust
items.Description: This volatile powder explodes into a ball of fire when thrown. It can be very useful against groups of foes.

items.Name: Flail of Oblivion
items.Description: This flail bears an enchantment whose origins cannot be discerned.
PropertiesDecoded: Negative Energy Ray (3) Cast Spell 5 Charges/Use

items.Name: Flashstar Dart
items.Description: This small dart explodes in a blinding flash of light upon striking its target.

items.Name: Flash powder
items.Description: This glittering powder can create a temporary aura of light when sprinkled on an object or person.

items.Name: Folds of Twilight
items.Description: Such armor is worn only by the highest masters of the League of Twilight, augmenting their skills.

items.Name: Wolf Pelt
items.Description: The luxurious fur of this large animal pelt is exceptionally soft and light, and could only have come from the legendary great timber wolf of distant Aggerfjor. Coats made from such pelts are currently very fashionable among the Belerian nobility, and thus should fetch a very go…

items.Name: Gareth's Instructions
items.Description:
Read this carefully and return it to me right away.

I want you to ask Loriana about a job called the "Varastii Heist". She will instruct you to steal an amulet from the estate of the Varastii family, who live in the Upper City. Do so. However, instead of returning it to her as …

items.Name: Golem Governor
items.Description: This small mechanism can be used to issue commands to Fergus's iron golem. When pointed at a creature or object, it commands to golem to attack. It's unclear at what range this device works.
PropertiesDecoded: Unique Power Cast Spell Unlimited Uses/Day

items.Name: Grazna's Hinge
items.Description: The gnomish archmage known as Grazna'tnaabrixan Kuu'Dlamnerix (Grazna, for short) had perfected the art of enchanting mechanical items of all sorts. One of his most famous inventions was an intelligent hinge joint which, when fitted to an ordinary chest, would turn it into an an…

items.Name: Great Flail of Oblivion
items.Description: This flail bears an enchantment whose origins cannot be discerned.
PropertiesDecoded: Negative Energy Burst (5) Cast Spell 1 Use/Day
Lawful Enhancement Bonus vs. Alignment Group +3
Chaotic Evil Use Limitation: Specific Alignment

items.Name: Grey Tunic
items.Description: Such clothing is worn by low-level operatives of the League of Twilight, at the rank of "Greycloak".

items.Name: Guild Bag
items.Description: This is a standard bag useful for carrying miscellaneous items. You can donate anything held in the bag by speaking with Vico Fearnisbane.

items.Name: Guild's Bag of Holding
items.Description: This bag of holding was lent to you by the League of Twilight, and you will be required to return it.
PropertiesDecoded: Enhanced Container: Reduced Weight Content Weight: -100%

items.Name: Hand of Nhegeth
items.Description:
This dark gauntlet lies so perfectly still that even the air around it seems stationary. Though it is an item of great beauty, something about it disturbs the very fibers of your being.

This is the Hand of Nhegeth, an artifact whose origins are a mystery to even the wisest sage…
PropertiesDecoded: Unique Power Cast Spell Unlimited Uses/Day

items.Name: Hrukunga leaves
items.Description: When held under one's tongue, the leaves of the Hrukunga weed bestow a certain amount of vitality, albeit briefly.

items.Name: Human bones
items.Description: These are human bones.

items.Name: Human hair
items.Description: This is a single human hair. It is long and completely black in color.

items.Name: Human skull
items.Description: This is a human skull.

items.Name: Iceberry
items.Description: This small berry is very cold to the touch. If dissolved on the tongue it allows one to exhale a breath of penetrating frost. However, there is a small chance that the berry will pop inside one's mouth, causing severe cold damage.
PropertiesDecoded: Dragon Breath, Cold Cast Spell Single Use

items.Name: Icon of Life
items.Description:
This small statuette emanates a feeling of safety and comfort.

The magic with which this icon is imbued is truly wondrous. If the person who has it in their possession dies, their soul is kept within the statuette and prevented from fleeing to the afterlife. It may then return …

items.Name: Irydian Necklace
items.Description: Gemstones from the Irydian mines of southeast Sardathia are valued not only for their beauty, but for the white light they emanate. This fine necklace is adorned with several small samples of these rare jewels.

items.Name: Slam 1d6+4 (+1d6 Acid + Paralyze)
PropertiesDecoded: Paralysis (Gelatinous Cube Poison) On Hit Cast Spell Level 6

items.Name: Rust Beetle Bite
PropertiesDecoded: Construct Attack Bonus vs. Racial Group +10
Construct Damage Bonus vs. Racial Type 2d12 Damage
Slay Racial Group On Hit DC=16
Ruin Armor (Bebilith) On Hit Cast Spell Level 8

items.Name: Amethyst
items.Description: The most valued amethyst crystals are a milky, wine-dark purple. Some say that the original Amethyst was a young priestess favored by both Sune and Selune. The two goddesses fought over the girl and, in their folly, destroyed her. A single glance from Selune turned the girl into…

items.Name: Baktunut
items.Description: Although the hard shell of the baktunut gives it a daunting appearance, the soft milky interior is incredibly tasty.

items.Name: Large eggs
items.Description: These are some very large eggs. You hope that whatever creature laid them does not find them in your possession.

items.Name: Baktunut
items.Description: This baktunut is lighter that you'd expect. In fact, it appears to be hollow.
PropertiesDecoded: Unique Power Self Only Cast Spell Single Use

items.Name: Rations
items.Description: These are some basic food rations.

items.Name: Sunflower seeds
items.Description: These are normal sunflower seeds.

items.Name: Junta berries
items.Description: These bitter berries can be used to cure minor scrapes and bruises.
PropertiesDecoded: Cure Minor Wounds (1) Cast Spell Single Use

items.Name: Hrlanthr's Ear
items.Description: This is the right ear of the half-orc Hrlanthr.

items.Name: Clangeddin's Lager
items.Description: This is among the finest lagers of the dwarven master brewers.
PropertiesDecoded: Alcohol, Beer Cast Spell Single Use

items.Name: Night's Defense
items.Description: These clever shields help to conceal their owner from spying eyes. However, like most shields, they make one's walk less stealthy.

items.Name: Valariel's Body
items.Description: This is the body of Valariel, highpriestess of Selene. Perhaps if you bring it back to the temple quickly, the clerics there will be able to bring her back to life.

items.Name: Pages from a Diary
items.Description:
These are some pages which have been ripped out of a diary.

"6/28: Betrayers! How dare they speak of honor when they do such things! When they mutilate a man simply because he disobeyed their foolish orders! I shall serve them no longer!"

Several entries here are angrily scrat…

items.Name: Temple Ledger
items.Description: This journal is filled with many notes and tabulations which keep track of temple purchases and expenses. Most of the income comes from donations, particularly by wealthy citizens hoping that accompanying prayers with gold makes them heard more readily. Expenses primarily consis…

items.Name: Panther's Eye Ring
items.Description: After many years of searching, the sorceress Jhirlaxia came into possession of the fabled Scarab of the Vayyarthim. She became so paranoid about someone stealing it that she sacrificed her own familiar, Grathu, and fixed its eye onto a ring. This ring enabled her to see through …

items.Name: Deformed Human Skull
items.Description: This skull seems human, but it is severely deformed, as if crushed very slowly by a powerful hand.

items.Name: Jadwiga's Vestments
items.Description: Queen Jadwiga's reign was one of the most peaceful and prosperous ages of Endorrian history. Without doubt, this was due in large part to her uncanny abilities as a leader and diplomat. More cynical historians add that those abilities may have had something to do with her partic…

items.Name: Journal of Kruor Irithukiir
items.Description: This enormous tome, bound in thick metal, must be hundreds of years old. The first half of it, about six hundred pages, is filled with writing. It seems to be written in many different handwriting styles. Some styles persist for many dozens of pages, some for but a few. You flip…

items.Name: Journal of Kruor Irithukiir
items.Description: This enormous tome, bound in thick metal, must be hundreds of years old. The first half of it, about six hundred pages, is filled with writing. It seems to be written in many different handwriting styles. Some styles persist for many dozens of pages, some for but a few. You flip…

items.Name: Threatening Note
items.Description: "Know this: He who fails to repay his debts will find that his children are orphans!"

items.Name: Kamia's Mark
items.Description: The hilt of this nasty looking dagger is inscribed with elegant letters spelling out the words: "Do not struggle, love, and accept my cold embrace".

items.Name: Mysterious Note
items.Description:
"I know what you're up to. Speak with me in the Tavern Under the Grinning Gargoyle - I will be in the feast room.

-Karol Norvath"

items.Name: Kragholm Stout
items.Description: A hearty, but very heavy brew from the mountain kingdom of Kragholm.
PropertiesDecoded: Alcohol, Beer Cast Spell Single Use

items.Name: Kragholm Token
items.Description:
This small runestone was given to you by one of the dwarves you rescued from the Skaern Mines. It is inscribed with a symbol representing allies of Kragholm, the mountain kingdom of the dwarves that lies north of Beleria.

[This item may be used in future modules set in the Rune…

items.Name: Krakalbrew
items.Description: This is a simple brew from the city of Krakalgrad, very tasty.
PropertiesDecoded: Alcohol, Beer Cast Spell Single Use

items.Name: Kruor's Armor
items.Description: Such armor is worn only by the highest masters of the League of Twilight, augmenting their skills.

items.Name: Diamond
items.Description: This transparent crystal is the hardest substance found in nature. The most valued color is a clear bluish-white; most lesser stones are clear white or off-white, but other less valued color varieties are known, among them mauve, pink, peach, and chartreuse. Due to its hardness,…

items.Name: Merthurian Brooch
items.Description: This ornate copper brooch is inlaid with specks of gold and is probably worth a good sum of money. It has the symbol of the Merthurian Mercantile Company inscribed upon it: a triangular mandala of three rings.

items.Name: Letter from the Shadow Thieves
items.Description:
Inside this envelope you find a letter.

"We are pleased with your progress, agent Skul. As long as you continue to act like a half-wit, you will not appear as a threat and your operation will not attract attention.

Continue to gather information on the organizational structure…

items.Name: Letter from Samar Latham
items.Description:
"Dear Lord Kellarian,

It has come to my attention that certain members of the Merthurian Mercantile Company are in league with thieves and murderers. I am not at liberty to reveal my sources, but I hope that our long friendship allows me the honor of your trust. In particular, …

items.Name: Letter to Gorin
items.Description:
"Gorin,

Your task is simple, so don't screw up like you did last time. All you have to do is go to the marketplace in Endorr and spend a few hours looking at the merchandise. A thief named Derent Skul will approach you and pick your pockets. Don't be alarmed - this is part of t…

items.Name: Light Properties
PropertiesDecoded: Immunity: Spells by Level Level 9 or Lower

items.Name: Juju'baka charm
items.Description: This spindle-shaped piece of wood has a piece of bone stuck in a small hollow. It appears to have no use, though the bone must surely symbolise something.

items.Name: Lock of Hair
items.Description: This small lock of hair, of a dramatic red color, is clearly human.

items.Name: Lor the creator
items.Description:
"Praise the will of Lor,
the will that creates,
the will that spins existence.

Praise the purpose of Lor,
the purpose which makes,
the purpose which stands against the Void.

Let all that live and all that age,
that which burns and that which flows,
the sky and earth which make…

items.Name: Shadow Armor
items.Description: The Sardathian Shadow Thieves are known to have deep pockets, and while they may employ countless gutter thugs and petty crooks, their elite core members are equipped very well indeed. Items such as Shadow Armor have occasionally been recovered from events where their involvemen…

items.Name: Dariush's Armor
items.Description: This fine armor is inscribed with symbols of the moon goddess, Selene.

items.Name: Dariush's Armor
items.Description: This fine armor is inscribed with symbols of the moon goddess, Selene.

items.Name: Dariush's Armor
items.Description: This fine armor is inscribed with symbols of the moon goddess, Selene.

items.Name: Mask of Shadows
items.Description: This mask is made from a black fabric with a strange metallic gleam that appears to attract shadows. Doubtless it is the work of Lunder Kaul, alchemist of shade. Once per day, the mask can bend light around its wearer so as to make him or her temporarily invisible.

items.Name: Aslyferund Elven Chain
items.Description: These fine mesh suits feel more like cloth than armor, yet many a killing blow has been turned aside by their links. Aslyferund, the most famous armorer of once-proud Myth Drannor, crafted many of these masterpieces personally, and it is rumored that the more powerful versions w…

items.Name: Merthurian Robes
items.Description: These ornate robes are worn by highly-ranked members of the Merthurian Mercantile Guild.

items.Name: Moonstar mace
items.Description: This mace funnels the energy of the Moon goddess, Selene.

items.Name: Pagan Societies, volume 7 - The Odoun
items.Description: For hundreds of years, the Black Marsh had been the home to an outcast human subculture known as the Odoun people. Thought to be descended from the original settlers of northeast Beleria, the odoun were an extremely reclusive and closed society. Rampant inbreeding led to their p…

items.Name: Muddy boots
items.Description: These boots are coated in mud and grease. They don't seem to be worth much.

items.Name: Nhegeth Properties
PropertiesDecoded: Immunity: Spells by Level Level 9 or Lower

items.Name: Scroll
items.Description:
Various notes are written in code upon this scroll. You can't make much sense of the text, but the names are quite familiar.

"The tooth feeds on the meat. Magic falls upon the floor."

"The hand places the coins in the chest. Only by walking backward do you move forward. Step q…

items.Name: A note
items.Description: [note text]

items.Name: Note from Dariush
items.Description:
"Are you a fool? Do not enter my house until you have the trust of the guild. If they see us speaking together then both our lives will be forfeit!

DV"

items.Name: Notes on Elemental Balancing
items.Description: The pages of this notebook are covered with scribbled notes. They appear to discuss Havikaar's research into the manner in which the world was created by the god of will, Lor. There is no time to delve deeply into this formidable tome, but quickly skimming over some of the passa…

items.Name: Excerpt
items.Description:
This page appears to be an excerpt from a longer text, but you can't locate the pages that come before or after.

"...had decided to assign his master assassin to my service. This creature is truly formidable, a ghostly elven man named Kruor Irithukiir. As far as I can tell, thi…

items.Name: Oil of Blessed Upheaving
items.Description: When this thick black oil is rubbed all over one's body, its revolting smell induces violent vomiting. Unpleasant as this may be, the experience purges one of various ills and curses.
PropertiesDecoded: Lesser Restoration (3) Cast Spell Single Use

items.Name: Old Armor
items.Description: This chainmain armor has been damaged in battle, but a skilled smith could probably restore it.

items.Name: Oris Ogenoff and the Edge of the World
items.Description: In 1062 LR, the famous explorer Oris Ogenoff set out westward over the Obsidian Ocean, in search of the lost island of the Vayyarthim. For forty days his ship sailed in pursuit of the setting sun. Many were the beasts of the sea that Oris and his comrades fought, and many were t…

items.Name: Portable Portal
items.Description: This ring teleports you to the cheat location.
PropertiesDecoded: Unique Power Self Only Cast Spell Unlimited Uses/Day

items.Name: Potion of See Invisibility
items.Description: This potion gives one the ability to see that which lies hidden.
PropertiesDecoded: See Invisibility (3) Cast Spell Single Use

items.Name: Potion of Stoneskin
items.Description: Whoever drinks this thick liquid will feel his/her skin toughen and become more resistant to damage.

items.Name: Potion of Truesight
items.Description: This bottle is filled with a most exquisite liquid. When you look through the bottle, objects behind it appear clearer than they truly are. The liquid bestows such clarity of vision to whomever drinks it.
PropertiesDecoded: True Seeing (9) Cast Spell Single Use

items.Name: Preserved Tooth
items.Description: This molar has been preserved through some kind of Abjurative magic. A small note is attached to it by a piece of string. The note is inscribed with only two letters: "HI"

items.Name: Bag
items.Description: You found this bag lying in your prison cell when you woke up. How it got there is a mystery to you.

items.Name: Prison Guard Uniform
items.Description: This is the uniform worn by some of the guards working in the Endorr prison.

items.Name: Crumpled Note
items.Description: "Take these darts, and throw some at the guard. When he comes into your cell run past him and to the right. Go through the large doors and hide. Don't let the torturer see you. Sneak your way to the far left corner, where you will find a trapdoor in the floor. Jump down through …

items.Name: Prison Rags
items.Description: These tattered rags are all that is given to inmates at the prison of Endorr.

items.Name: Purple rose
items.Description: This rare purple rose must be very valuable.

items.Name: Rana Charm
items.Description:
This is the body of a Kzantan blue frog that has been dried and preserved.

If one throws this at a foe and spits at their feet, this bestows a powerful curse.
PropertiesDecoded: Bestow Curse (11) Cast Spell Single Use

items.Name: Sack of Angry Rats
items.Description:
Several angry rats are contained within this heavy leather sack. If you place it on the ground, they will be released and will attack the first creature they see.

This can be useful for creating havoc, especially if one is stealthy.

items.Name: Ring of Irithukiir
items.Description: In 877 LR, Lunnr the conqueror slew a clan of wood elves in the forests of Grimwood. Over the next seven years, each and every one of Lunnr's soldiers, and each and every member of their families, was brutally slain. Always at night, always with a single dagger driven into the s…

items.Name: Ring of Shadowlight
items.Description:
Lunder Kaul was fascinated by the enchantment of shadows. One of his most successful creations was a metal that attracts shadows, presumably discovered during one of his trips to the depths of the earth.

This magical ring is made from such a metal. It emanates a faint aura of d…

items.Name: Rod of Shadows
items.Description: Lunder Kaul was fascinated by the enchantment of shadows. He was able to capture individual shadows within a glass rod such as this. When the rod is broken, the shadows are released and can enfold a single creature for a short time.

items.Name: Secret Passages
items.Description: This tome describes the art of constructing secret doors. It is written in two parts: The first deals with techniques of concealment and mechanisms that can be built without the use of magic. The second describes the arcane arts used to create hiding illusions. The last chapter …

items.Name: Severed Hand
items.Description: This is Dariush Valyana's severed hand, preserved in wax.

items.Name: Shadow Thief log
items.Description:
These papers supposedly carry information about a planned coup by the Shadow Thieves of Sardathia against the League of Twilight. However, it is essentially incomprehensible as it is written in code. Here are some example passages:

"The red chair leans against the northwest wal…

items.Name: Shadow-weave blade
items.Description: Lunder Kaul was fascinated by the enchantment of shadows. One of his most successful creations was a metal that attracts shadows, presumably discovered during one of his trips to the depths of the earth. The source of this metal is unknown, but daggers made from it have been ver…

items.Name: Shovel
items.Description: This is an old shovel.

items.Name: Signet ring of Lin'Litharn
items.Description: After an illusion is lifted from it, the ring reveals an inscription written in an ancient form of elvish: "Until the sun itself rests in slumber, and the wind finally settles in its home, so shall we watch over the world". It appears that this is a royal signet ring of the Lin'…

items.Name: Silent Shoes
items.Description: These shoes are made from exquisitely soft leather, and make almost no sound when worn.

items.Name: Skara Loa
items.Description: After the systematic extermination by the armies of Rothald of Asilgard in 766 LR, the hedge wizards of the Black Marsh were thought to be gone from the world. However, some of their artifacts continue to surface to this day, suggesting that their society still exists, scattered…

items.Name: Skeleton Key
items.Description: When used by a skilled thief, this complex key can open almost any lock. However, it can only be used once, breaking in the process.

items.Name: Small Diamond
items.Description: This transparent crystal is the hardest substance found in nature. The most valued color is a clear bluish-white; most lesser stones are clear white or off-white, but other less valued color varieties are known, among them mauve, pink, peach, and chartreuse. Due to its hardness,…

items.Name: Smoke Dust
items.Description: When this pouch is thrown onto the ground, the powder within explodes into a cloud which temporarily makes the user invisible. This allows one to quickly dart out of view.

items.Name: Snakefang Dagger
items.Description: When squeezed, the handle of this cruel dagger squirts a poison onto the blade which can stun the victim for a few seconds. This is often enough time for the wielder to finish the job. Such knives are sometimes wielded by assassins working for the League of Twilight.

items.Name: Sonnets and Poems
items.Description: This book contains many classic poems from some of Beleria's most famous bards and artists. The pages are dog-eared and worn, indicating that the book has been often read by its owner.

items.Name: Staff of Conjuring
items.Description: Staves of Conjuring vary widely in design and abilities. Some, like this one, are designed for battle.

items.Name: Star of Creation
items.Description:
This gem appears magnificently beautiful, and appears to be imbued with magical powers.

Such gems are often used as holy symbols of the god Lor, creator of the universe.

items.Name: Star of Oblivion
items.Description:
At first glance, this gem appears magnificently beautiful. However, after longer inspection, you sense there is something false about it. You feel uneasy about holding it in your hand.

items.Description: Deep within the dark forest of Grimwood, there is a cave that sings. Few have ever heard its song, for the dark forest is filled with beasts most fierce. Stories abound of giant wolves, spiders ten feet it diameter, and giants whose footsteps make the very earth tremble in fear.…

items.Description: In the year 1255 LR, King Velhar of Endorr fell ill to a mysterious illness and passed away. items.Description: According to legend, much of the land that is now Beleria was once a lush jungle inhabited by a race of elf-like creatures called the Vayyarthim. items.Description: In 877 LR, Lunnr the conqueror slew a clan of wood elves in the forests of Grimwood. items.Name: The Purple Witch
items.Description: The children of Tchka'danath, especially the very naughty ones, often hear tales of the Purple Witch. items.Name: The Religions of Men
items.Description:
This book briefly describes the major religions practiced in the human nations of Beleria, Sardathia, and Akkaban. These three regions share many dieties, but each emphasizes some more than others.

items.Description: This transparent crystal is the hardest substance found in nature. items.Name: Broken tooth
items.Description: This broken human tooth has a small hole drilled in one end. It looks as those it was once worn on a string around Gund's neck.

items.Name: Tools of Twilight
items.Description: Such tools are the hallmark of the thieves working for the League of Twilight.

items.Name: Tooth of the Night
items.Description: Since the late 1200's, the predominant thieving guild in the city of Endorr has been known as the League of Twilight. items.Name: Twilight Dagger
items.Description: Such daggers are used by low-level assassins working for the League of Twilight.

items.Name: Mace of Moonlight
items.Description: The head of this magical mace is a complex weave made from strands of moonlight frozen into solid form by powerful abjurations. Such weapons are only wielded by respected warrior priests of the moon goddess, Selene.

items.Description: When thrown into one's eyes, this fine powder briefly stings, but then it bestows a clarity of mind and protection against certain mind-affecting magic.

items.Name: Alchemist's Fire
items.Description: Alchemist's Fire is a sticky, adhesive substance that ignites when exposed to air. Anyone hit by it will suffer 1d6 points of fire damage. It may also be used to coat a weapon so it will gain a 1d4 fire damage bonus for a short duration.

items.Description: The Nightthief was a vicious assassin who specialized in fighting with two daggers. His Nimbleknife was the weaker of the two items, but it granted him greater abilities in combat. items.Name: Cutlass
items.Description: A favorite of scurvy scallywags everywhere.

items.Name: Xzingko root
items.Description: When eaten, the nutrients of the Xzingko root course quickly through the blood and settle into the skin, briefly armoring it against damage.

items.Name: Your left hand
items.Description: This is your left hand, cut off by Highpriestess Valariel in an effort to rid you of the Hand of Nhegeth. It has been wrapped in bandages, and hopefully someday you will find someone who may be able to re-attach it.

items.Name: Zacho's Sword
items.Description: Though dented and scratched from years of use, this sword still retains its fine balance and magical enhancements. It was a gift from Zacho Nefzen, in gratitude for saving his son from orc raiders.
